title: Choose your publishing path

stage.name: Published
stage.description: The story is finished, bound and ready to share.

intro: Sharing the story you wrote together.

questions.prompt: Match each term to what it means.
pairs: A publisher handles printing and selling
The author handles and pays for publishing
questions.why: Both paths can lead to a book in readers' hands. They differ in who does what.

questions.prompt: In traditional publishing, what usually comes first?
questions.why: Most authors send a query letter to agents, who then pitch the book to publishers.

questions.prompt: Self-published authors are responsible for editing, cover design and marketing.
questions.why: They can hire help, but the choices and costs are theirs.

questions.prompt: For a couple, publishing is choosing to share your story. What should that next step be?
options: A commitment you choose together, when you're both ready
Rushing so you don't lose momentum
questions.why: The right next step is the one you both choose, freely.

talk: What would a meaningful next step look like for the two of you?
